candidates.label: Four-name tasbih opening grounding the unlettered Messenger's commission
candidates.definition: In 62:1-2: Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise; it is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom although they were before in clear error.

evidence.excerpt: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡمَلِكِ ٱلۡقُدُّوسِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي ٱلۡأُمِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمۡ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلُ لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Mission extending beyond contemporaries framed entirely as divine bounty
candidates.definition: In 62:3-4: And to others of them who have not yet joined them; and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise; that is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

evidence.excerpt: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَمَّا يَلۡحَقُواْ بِهِمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: ذَٰلِكَ فَضۡلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Torah-bearers who failed to carry it likened to a book-laden donkey
candidates.definition: In 62:5: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes of books; wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah.

evidence.excerpt: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُواْ ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَحۡمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلۡحِمَارِ يَحۡمِلُ أَسۡفَارَۢاۚ بِئۡسَ مَثَلُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهۡدِي ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Exclusive-alliance claim tested by the death-wish challenge
candidates.definition: In 62:6-7: Say O you who are Jews if you claim that you are allies of Allah excluding other people then wish for death if you should be truthful; but they will not wish for it ever because of what their hands have put forth.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوٓاْ إِن زَعَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دُونِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَهُۥٓ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Death fleeing futile with return to the Knower of unseen and witnessed
candidates.definition: In 62:8: Say indeed the death from which you flee, indeed it will meet you; then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed and He will inform you about what you used to do.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَفِرُّونَ مِنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَٰقِيكُمۡۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Jumu'ah obligation: leave trade for remembrance, disperse after prayer
candidates.definition: In 62:9-10: O you who have believed when the call is made for prayer on the day of Jumu'ah then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade, that is better for you if you only knew; and when the prayer has been concluded disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah and remember Allah often that you may succeed.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Trade and diversion subordinated to what is with Allah as best provider
candidates.definition: In 62:11: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion they rushed to it and left you standing; say what is with Allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allah is the best of providers.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡاْ تِجَٰرَةً أَوۡ لَهۡوًا ٱنفَضُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِمٗاۚ قُلۡ مَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهۡوِ وَمِنَ ٱلتِّجَٰرَةِۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّـٰزِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
